card.name: Words before alternative causes of liver injury
card.fires_on: Small words like other, another, an, a, no, possible or alternative that come right before cause or etiology. They appear where the text says to rule out or exclude other causes, mostly for liver enzyme rises or organ injury.

modes.label: Other/another before cause
modes.description: The word other or another introduces further causes to be excluded.
modes.example: Complete a comprehensive evaluation to rule out<< other>> causes of liver injury when drug-induced liver

modes.label: Absence of an alternative cause
modes.description: An article or no follows 'absence of' or 'without' and leads into a cause or etiology.
modes.example: Discontinue XCOPRI in patients with evidence of liver injury in the absence of<< an>> alternative etiology.

card.writes: It pushes toward words like alternative, conf and cov, which suggests it sets up wording about alternative or confounding explanations.
card.plain: It marks the little word just before 'cause' or 'etiology' when the label says to look for other explanations of liver or lung injury.
